title: eucalyptus populnea var. obconica
intro: Eucalyptus populnea var. obconica, commonly known as the Dwarf Blue Gum or Tasmanian Blue Gum, is a small to medium-sized tree native to the southwestern region of Western Australia and Tasmania. This plant is valued for its essential oil, which possesses numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eucalyptus populnea var. obconica include decongestant, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help relieve congestion, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eucalyptol, limonene, and alpha-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
